name: Maya Chen
blurb: Owns the ledger migration and the settlement webhook path. Writes in lowercase, ships on Thursdays, delegates to John when she is heads-down. Has never used the word 'excited' in a work message.

name: Dana Okafor
blurb: Maya's boss. Reads every weekly update and quotes them back in planning. Believes a PR open nine days is a diary entry. Prefers bad news early and short.

name: John Diaz
blurb: Backend engineer two years in. The person Maya hands work to when the ledger eats her week. Reliable, funny about it, would genuinely enjoy being right about a flaky test being a real bug.

name: Priya Raman
blurb: SRE for payments infrastructure. Owns staging, credentials, and the gateway. Deletes documentation that lies. Will tell you the p99 moved before you notice.

name: Sam Whitfield
blurb: PM for payments. Asks one clarifying question and then leaves you alone, which engineers regard as a superpower. Maintains a numbered list of deploy rules he cannot fully recite.

name: Lena Kowalski
blurb: Frontend on checkout. Ships large PRs with an apology attached. Takes fourteen review comments without flinching and rewrites the thing properly the next morning.
